new.Title: Mark attendance with valid employeeId, absent and date
new.Description: Verify marking attendance with valid employeeId, absent status and date returns 200 and attendance data
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing employeeId, absent and date
Verify response status is 200
Verify response body contains attendance data with employeeId, absent and date
new.Expected Result: Response status is 200 and response body contains attendance data with employeeId 1, absent false and date 2024-06-01

new.Title: Mark attendance with valid employeeId and absent
new.Description: Verify marking attendance with valid employeeId and absent status returns 200 and attendance data
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing employeeId and absent
Verify response status is 200
Verify response body contains attendance data with employeeId and absent
new.Expected Result: Response status is 200 and response body contains attendance data with employeeId 1 and absent true

new.Title: Mark attendance with missing employeeId
new.Description: Verify marking attendance with missing employeeId returns 400 with error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body missing employeeId
Verify response status is 400
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'
new.Expected Result: Response status is 400 and response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'

new.Title: Mark attendance with null request body
new.Description: Verify marking attendance with null request body returns 400 with error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with null body
Verify response status is 400
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'
new.Expected Result: Response status is 400 and response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'

new.Title: Mark attendance with missing absent field
new.Description: Verify marking attendance with missing absent field returns 400 with error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body missing absent
Verify response status is 400
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'
new.Expected Result: Response status is 400 and response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'

new.Title: Mark batch attendance with empty payload
new.Description: Send POST request to /mark-batch with an empty list
new.Pre-Conditions: Attendance service and repository are available
Test Steps: Prepare an empty list
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with empty list as JSON body
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'payload is empty'

new.Title: Mark batch attendance with valid payload
new.Description: Send POST request to /mark-batch with a valid list of attendance DTOs
new.Pre-Conditions: Attendance service and repository are available
Test Steps: Prepare a list of AttendanceDTO objects with valid employeeId, absent, and optional date
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as JSON body
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains savedCount equal to number of valid entries
Verify response body contains presentCount and absentCount matching input data
Verify response body contains invalidEntries as empty list

new.Title: Mark batch attendance with some invalid entries
new.Description: Send POST request to /mark-batch with list containing valid and invalid attendance DTOs
new.Pre-Conditions: Attendance service and repository are available
Test Steps: Prepare a list of AttendanceDTO objects where some have null employeeId or absent
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as JSON body
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains savedCount equal to number of valid entries
Verify response body contains invalidEntries list with employeeIds of invalid entries
Verify presentCount and absentCount match valid entries

new.Title: Mark batch attendance with null payload
new.Description: Send POST request to /mark-batch with null body
new.Pre-Conditions: Attendance service and repository are available
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with null body
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'payload is empty'

new.Title: Mark batch attendance with null DTO in list
new.Description: Send POST request to /mark-batch with list containing null element
new.Pre-Conditions: Attendance service and repository are available
Test Steps: Prepare a list of AttendanceDTO objects with one element as null
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as JSON body
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains savedCount equal to number of valid entries
Verify invalidEntries list is empty
Verify presentCount and absentCount match valid entries

new.Title: Get all employees when no employees exist
new.Description: Verify that GET /api/employe returns an empty list when no employees exist
new.Pre-Conditions: No employees exist in the database
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employe
Receive response
new.Expected Result: Response status is 200 OK and response body contains an empty list

new.Title: Get all employees successfully
new.Description: Verify that GET /api/employe returns a list of all employees
new.Pre-Conditions: At least one employee exists in the database
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employe
Receive response
new.Expected Result: Response status is 200 OK and response body contains a list of employees

new.Title: Get employee by non-existing id
new.Description: Verify that the API returns 404 when employee with given id does not exist
new.Pre-Conditions: No employee with given id exists in the database
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employe/{id} with non-existing employee id
new.Expected Result: Response status 404 Not Found with message 'employee not found'

new.Title: Get employee with null id
new.Description: Verify that the API returns 400 when id path parameter is null
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employe/{id} with null or missing id
new.Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'id is required'

new.Title: Get employee by valid id
new.Description: Verify that the API returns employee details when a valid id is provided
new.Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the database
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employe/{id} with valid employee id
new.Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with employee details in the response body

new.Title: Create employee with valid name and role
new.Description: Verify creating an employee with valid name and role returns 201 and employee data
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with valid name and role in body
new.Expected Result: Response status is 201 Created with Location header and response body contains created employee with id, name, and role

new.Title: Create employee with missing name
new.Description: Verify creating an employee without name returns 400 with error message
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with role only in body
new.Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

new.Title: Create employee with missing role
new.Description: Verify creating an employee without role returns 400 with error message
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with name only in body
new.Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

new.Title: Create employee with empty name
new.Description: Verify creating an employee with empty name returns 400 with error message
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with empty name and valid role in body
new.Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

new.Title: Create employee with empty role
new.Description: Verify creating an employee with empty role returns 400 with error message
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with valid name and empty role in body
new.Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

new.Title: Create employee with null body
new.Description: Verify creating an employee with null request body returns 400 with error message
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with null body
new.Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

new.Title: Update employee with valid id and valid body
new.Description: Verify updating an existing employee with valid id and valid request body updates the employee and returns 200
new.Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the database
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with valid id
Include valid JSON body with fields to update
new.Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with updated employee object in response body

new.Title: Update employee with partial fields in request body
new.Description: Verify updating employee with partial fields updates only those fields and returns 200
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with valid id
Include request body with only some fields (e.g. only name)
new.Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with employee object updated only for provided fields

new.Title: Update employee with non-existing id
new.Description: Verify updating employee with id that does not exist returns 404 with error message
new.Pre-Conditions: No employee exists with given id
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with non-existing id
Include valid request body
new.Expected Result: Response status 404 Not Found with body {"message":"employee not found"}

new.Title: Update employee with null request body
new.Description: Verify updating employee with null request body returns 400 with error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with valid id
Do not include request body or send null body
new.Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with body {"message":"request body is required"}

new.Title: Update employee with null id
new.Description: Verify updating employee with null id returns 400 with error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with id as null or missing
new.Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with body {"message":"id is required"}

new.Title: Delete employee with valid id
new.Description: Verify deleting an existing employee by valid id returns 204 No Content
new.Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the database
Test Steps: Send DELETE request to /api/employee/{id} with valid existing id
new.Expected Result: Response status is 204 No Content and employee is deleted from database

new.Title: Delete employee with null id
new.Description: Verify deleting an employee with null id returns 400 id is required
Test Steps: Send DELETE request to /api/employee/{id} with id as null or missing
new.Expected Result: Response status is 400 with body {"message":"id is required"}

new.Title: Delete employee with non-existing id
new.Description: Verify deleting an employee with non-existing id returns 404 employee not found
new.Pre-Conditions: No employee exists with the given id
Test Steps: Send DELETE request to /api/employee/{id} with non-existing id
new.Expected Result: Response status is 404 with body {"message":"employee not found"}
